title: nf-core/updhmm pipeline parameters
description: Pipeline for detecting UPD events using R package UPDhmm

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/updhmm/usage#samplesheet-input).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

pipeline_specific_options.title: Pipeline-specific options
pipeline_specific_options.description: Parameters specific to the UPDhmm pipeline

genome_build.help_text: Specify the reference genome build used. Must be either 'hg38' (GRCh38) or 'hg19' (GRCh37).

GQ_min.help_text: Minimum genotype quality (GQ) score for variant filtering. Only variants where ALL trio members meet this threshold are retained.

DP_min.help_text: Minimum read depth (DP) for variant filtering. Only variants where ALL trio members meet this depth threshold are retained.

is_gvcf.description: Input files are in gVCF format
is_gvcf.help_text:
Set to TRUE if input VCF files are in genomic VCF (gVCF/GVCF) format. When enabled, the pipeline uses the GVCF_COMBINE subworkflow which:

• Combines trio gVCFs using GATK4 CombineGVCFs
• Performs joint genotyping with GATK4 GenotypeGVCFs
• Follows GATK best practices for multi-sample calling

This mode REQUIRES --fasta, --fai, and --dict reference genome files. When disabled (default), the pipeline uses bcftools-based VCF merging (VCF_COMBINE subworkflow).

perform_intersection.description: Perform variant intersection across trio members
perform_intersection.help_text:
Enable variant intersection mode where only genomic positions with variant calls in ALL three trio members are retained before merging. Implemented in the VCF_COMBINE subworkflow using BCFTOOLS_ISEC with '-n=3 -c all'.

• TRUE: Intersection mode - retains only shared variants
• FALSE: Union mode - combines all variants directly

When enabled, missing genotypes are NOT filled (BCFTOOLS_SETGT is skipped in FILTER_LOWCONF).

apply_vaf_filter.description: Mask ambiguous VAF regions per individual
apply_vaf_filter.help_text:
Enable detection and masking of genomic regions with ambiguous Variant Allele Frequency (VAF) patterns that may represent technical artifacts, contamination, or mosaicism. Implemented in the REMOVE_ANNOTATIONS subworkflow, which:

• Extracts variants with VAF in ambiguous ranges per individual:
 - 0.15 = VAF = 0.30 
 - 0.70 = VAF = 0.85
• Converts ambiguous variants to BED format
• Integrates with SV_MASK_BED subworkflow to exclude these regions

apply_vaf_correction.help_text:
Enable VAF-based genotype correction to adjust heterozygous calls with extreme allele frequencies. Implemented in the FILTER_LOWCONF subworkflow using BCFTOOLS_SETGT_VAF with sequential corrections:

• GT 0/1 ? 0/0 when VAF < 0.15 
• GT 0/1 ? 1/1 when VAF > 0.85 

Applied independently to each trio member (proband, mother, father).

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome files and masking regions

fasta.description: Path to reference genome FASTA file
fasta.help_text:
Path to the reference genome FASTA file. REQUIRED when --is_gvcf is TRUE for GATK operations.

The reference must:
• Match the reference used for original variant calling
• Correspond to the genome build specified in --genome_build (hg38 or hg19)
• Be indexed (companion .fai file required, see --fai parameter)
• Have a sequence dictionary (companion .dict file required, see --dict parameter).

fai.description: Path to reference genome FAI index
fai.help_text: Path to the FASTA index (.fai) file for the reference genome. REQUIRED when --is_gvcf is TRUE for GATK operations. This index file must correspond to the FASTA file specified in --fasta.

dict.help_text:
Path to the sequence dictionary (.dict) file for the reference genome. REQUIRED when --is_gvcf is TRUE for GATK operations.

This dictionary file must correspond to the FASTA file specified in --fasta.

excluded_regions_bed.description: BED file with regions to exclude
excluded_regions_bed.help_text:
Path to BED file containing genomic regions to exclude from analysis.

• If not provided and --genome_build is specified, the pipeline will automatically download the corresponding excluded regions file from Zenodo.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.
